title: Continuity of SEBI Nominee Directors
text: Continuity of SEBI Nominee Directors Apr 02, 1997| Circulars SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE BOARD OF INDIA SECONDARY MARKET DEPARTMENT Mittal Court, A Wing, Gr. Floor, 224, Nariman Point, Mumbai 400 021 SMD/POLICY/CIR/4-97 April 02, 1997 The Executive Directors/Managing Directors of all Stock Exchanges Dear Sir, Sub : Continuity of SEBI Nominee Directors SEBI has received queries from some Stock Exchanges regarding continuity of a SEBI Nominee Director in the event of his transfer/retirement. In this connection, it is to be informed that a SEBI Nominee Director will continue as such, till the time a new person is nominated in his place by SEBI, irrespective of his transfer/retirement. This clarification may also please be circulated to all the SEBI Nominee Directors in your Governing Board/Council of Members for their information. Thanking you, Yours faithfully, NAGENDRA PARAKH DIVISION CHIEF SECONDARY MARKET DEPARTMENT cc to a] Chairman’s Secretariat b] All Executive Directors, Divisions Chiefs and Regional Managers of SEBI c] All SEBI Nominee Directors on the Board of Exchanges d] All Division Chiefs are requested to circulate among all their officers
